newsitem.title: PERU: Comedian offers jokes to help in Peru hostage drama.
newsitem.headline: Comedian offers jokes to help in Peru hostage drama.

text.p: A Spanish comedian offered on Friday to ease tensions by telling jokes inside the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima where leftist rebels are holding nearly 400 hostages.
"If they (the rebels) are listening to me I would like them to let me in so that the time can pass pleasantly for the different groups," Francisco Carbonell told local radio outside the residence.
"I know the situation is difficult for everyone, but I believe it is a question of dialogue. I think humour is a very good vehicle," the comedian added.

About 20 heavily armed Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA), who stormed the residence in spectacular fashion late Tuesday, have demanded the government release up to 500 of their jailed comrades.
